title: coursekit
tagline: Local-first courses taught one unit at a time: read the lesson, drill, unlock the next unit.
notice: The courses are playable end to end and are corrected as they are used. Report mistakes on GitHub.

courses.blurb: A full beginner grammar course following A. B. Davidson's Introductory Hebrew Grammar, with parsing and production drills.
courses.source: A. B. Davidson, An Introductory Hebrew Grammar (22nd ed., 1923) and J. E. McFadyen's Key (1924) — public domain

courses.blurb: A shorter introduction built on an open textbook.
courses.source: Aaron Christianson, An Open Introduction to Biblical Hebrew (2014)
